query_plan.query: Which country has the lowest elevation? What is the name and the depth of this point?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by country, return the country, name and depth of the lowest elevation.
steps.query: Return all countries together with the name and depth of their lowest elevation.

extra.sql_query: SELECT countries.name, countries.lowest_point, countries.lowest_point_m FROM countries WHERE countries.lowest_point_m = ( SELECT MIN(countries.lowest_point_m) FROM countries )

s1.sql_query: SELECT countries.name, countries.lowest_point, countries.lowest_point_m FROM countries
